import pathlib, shutil, sys
cache = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
shared = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
for name, probe in (("zvec", "node_modules/.bin/zg"), ("zvec-model-cache", "")):
    tree = cache / name
    if not (tree / probe).exists():
        sys.exit("offline zvec 0.2.2 install is missing " + str(tree / probe) + ": this run has no registry access, so restore the cached tree under " + str(cache) + " before preparing")
    destination = shared / name
    if destination.exists():
        sys.exit("refusing to overwrite an existing " + str(destination))
    shutil.copytree(tree, destination, symlinks=True)
print("copied offline zvec 0.2.2 install from " + str(cache))
